purpose: Post hoc and descriptive, after v7s's, v7t's and v7u's records: the counts behind v7s's cells that its record does not hold. v7s's record gives each cell's b, c and n (flips) but not how many sessions each detector judged 'machine' on the plan side and on the recorded side, nor how far each session's margin was. D6 read 'not changed' in every series; whether that is because D6 judged the plans 'human' in the first place (nothing to flip) or because it judged them 'machine' and the path did not move them is not in the record. This run writes those counts, for D6 and, to compare, for every other valid detector. Nothing is read: no rule, no verdict.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-11-20 after v7s's record (9ff1d37a...), v7t's (a0649ae6...) and v7u's (63e5b89d...) and after the researcher's decision 2 (4) of .steering/20261120-paper-b-v0.19 (attack-me round 7 of paper B's manuscript v0.19: D6 was 'not changed' in every series but the number of sessions judged 'machine' at the plan is not in the record; count it post hoc and give it as a table). The counts below have not been computed or seen. Code: works/prototype_v7v.py, committed with this file; it imports v7u's code at ba4bfc8 (and through it v7s's at 5508490 and v7t's at 502f31e) unchanged and checks them byte for byte, and checks v7s's and v7u's records by their SHA-256 before reading anything. Amended before any value after the code review (code-reviewer, opus, and /cross-review, Claude and Codex, 2026-11-20): the margins' table no longer writes one person's or one session's value (H0, M3a and M3b, built from donors of E, without ends; a person-derived source's two sides by judgment only as counts unless both hold 21 values or more; every distribution of fewer than 5 values as its count); the sessions whose judgment and margin disagree are counted; the records' keys are checked before anything is scored; 'usable' joins the reproduction and the in-cell check; tests added for the records' SHA-256, the code checks, the write of the record and the variant h's restriction.
method: v7u's run up to the scores, unchanged: v7s's records and runlogs checked, KUPA, the persons and the scorer (v7u's persons_and_scorer), both variants of the recordings loaded and checked (t: v7s's loading; h: every Firefox capture's page at the handler's time), their unperturbed sides compared, the margins computed once from variant t (v7s's all_margins). Then, in each variant, v7s's score_series and v7s's criterion_cells and human_cells at theta 1, 0.5 and 2, unchanged. While v7s's criterion_cells runs at theta 1, v7s's cell_reading is wrapped to keep, per machine cell, the arrays of its first call (the observed reading: the scores of the plan side and of the recorded side, and the set of sessions the cell reads); the wrap returns cell_reading's own result unchanged and is removed afterwards.

count.judged: per variant, per series (v7's nine machine series M0, M1_8B, M1_14B, M1_replay_8B, M1_replay_14B, M2_8B, M2_14B, M3a, M3b; v7s's MC1, MC2, MC3, MC5, F_M0, F_M2_8B, F_M2_14B; the human series H1_idle, whose unperturbed side is H0, the 80 persons, and F_H1, whose unperturbed side is H0's first 10 persons), per side (base: the plan or H0; hook; page) and per valid detector (v7s's validity: D1, D2_lr, D2_rf, D3, D6 as in v7s's record; D4 and D5 are not valid and are not counted): the sessions (every unit of the series, including those without a plan or with a failed capture), the sessions with a judgment, and the sessions judged 'machine' (v7's judgments: D1 delta at or below 0.269, others probability above 0.5). Variant h is written for the page of Firefox's series only (F_M0, F_M2_8B, F_M2_14B, F_H1); every other side reads the same recordings in both variants and is written once, from variant t.
count.in_cell: per variant, per machine cell at theta 1 (series of v7 and v7s above, hook and page, valid detectors; variant h: Firefox's page cells only): within the set of sessions the cell's observed reading is made on (a plan, a judgment on both sides, a prediction), n and the number judged 'machine' on the plan side and on the recorded side; and b and c recomputed from them by v7's flips, which must equal the cell's observed b, c, n (the number of cells where they do not is written; 0 expected).
count.margins: per source of margins (H0 and every machine series whose margins are its own: M0, M1_8B, M1_14B, M2_8B, M2_14B, M3a, M3b, MC1, MC2, MC3, MC5) and valid detector: the sessions; those without an unperturbed judgment (no margin); those that flip at no sigma ('none'); the sessions whose margin and judgment disagree (0 expected: the margins were made from the same scores); and the distribution of the numeric margin_sd (v7s's criterion.margin_sd unchanged, in ms) by v7's summary: for the plans of M0, M1, M2 and MC with ends (min, p05, p25, median, p75, p95, max), for H0 and for M3a and M3b (built from donors, persons of E, in v7) without ends (p05 to p95); for every source only the count below 5 values. The same split by the unperturbed judgment ('machine' and 'human'): for the plans as above; for H0, M3a and M3b the two sides' distributions only if both sides hold 21 values or more (below that a 5th percentile involves one person's value, and a side and the whole together give the other's), else both sides as counts. Margins depend on the plan side only and are written once.
count.reproduction: the run's own cells against the deposited records, before anything is written: variant t against v7s's record at theta 1, 0.5 and 2 (every machine cell's observed and predicted reading and b, c, n; every human cell's observed and predicted b, c, n and reading where v7s gives one), against v7s's path_sd tables and against v7s's perturbation_jitter (v7s's jitter_table from this run's flip counts: every source, detector, share and first sigma); variants t and h against v7u's record (firefox_cells: observed and predicted reading and b, c, n of every Firefox machine cell at theta 1; f_h1: observed and predicted b, c, n). Written: the number compared and the number not as deposited, with the first ten keys of each part.

reading.none: No rule is read. The counts describe what v7s's cells were made of. They enter the manuscript (section VII on D6, or a table in supplement S6) only if 'usable' is true: every part of the reproduction is 0 not as deposited and every cell's in-cell b, c, n is its observed b, c, n in both variants; otherwise the parts not as deposited are written down and the counts are not used in the manuscript until the researcher decides.
reading.deposited_readings_unchanged: v7s's verdict, cells and readings, v7t's and v7u's readings stay as deposited and read. This run adds no reading of the criterion and changes none.

limits: Post hoc: written after the cells' b, c, n and readings were seen; only the counts named above are new. The judged counts are on the sessions each side has; a cell reads a smaller set (in_cell). The margin is v7s's software margin (Gaussian jitter on times), not a property of the path. H0's distribution is of 80 persons and is given without minimum or maximum; F_H1's counts are of 10 persons and are counts only.
record: results/prototype_v7v/record.json: the counts above, 'usable', and provenance (HEAD, dirty, conditions and code SHA-256, v7s's and v7u's record SHA-256). No press time, gap, key, text or person identifier; no value of one person (H0, F_H1, M3a, M3b: counts and quantiles over 5 or more, the split by judgment over 21 or more on both sides). The plans' minimum and maximum (M0, M1, M2, MC: machine sessions, no person) are given. Refuses to overwrite.
